# `errors.aug`

<a id="symbol-load"></a>
## `load` · [source](errors.aug#L2)

The caller supplies `fail` as `bool`. The result is `string`. It can fail with `FileError`. If `fail` is true, it fails with a new `FileError`. Otherwise, it returns `"loaded"`.
